item.title: [Peter Yang] 谷歌10万员工内测AI工具，这其实是隐藏优势
item.description:
@petergyang · 查看 X 原推文 ↗

中文翻译

大家都爱调侃谷歌公司大、官僚气重，但我倒觉得，他们的一大竞争优势在于：在正式大范围发布之前，有超过10万名员工在测试他们最新的模型和工具。

员工规模到了这个量级，你甚至可以在内部员工中做A/B测试，而且结果还能达到统计显著性 :)

英文原推文

People make fun of Google for being large and bureaucratic but I think one of their competitive advantages is they have 100,000+ employees testing their latest models and tools before wide release.

At that employee population you can even run staff-only A/B tests that are stat sig :)

item.title: [Swyx] 刷社交媒体时，别忘了这个套路
item.description:
@swyx · 查看 X 原推文 ↗

中文翻译

刷社交媒体的时候，我觉得有件事值得记在心里：你可以说“达到SOTA的概率已经降到零了”，然后收获一大堆点赞；三个月后人家真达到了SOTA，你再发个道歉声明，点赞反而更多。而你写的那个对象，还会把你的话打印出来，谢谢你给的动力。

说错话完全没代价，夸张反而处处有奖励，X的算法就是照着这个逻辑调的。

英文原推文

when scrolling social media i think it is worth bearing in mind that you can say “odds of reaching SOTA have dropped to zero” and get alot of likes and then 3 months later when they have reached SOTA you post apology form and get even more likes and the subject of your writing prints it out and thanks you for motivation

theres no consequences at all for inaccuracy and every incentive for hyperbole and the x algorithm is tuned for this

item.title: [Thibault Sottiaux] ChatGPT 移动端新体验来了
item.description:
@thsottiaux · 查看 X 原推文 ↗

中文翻译

我们正在为 ChatGPT 打造全新的移动端体验！

新界面让你更容易找到常用功能，也更容易发现 ChatGPT 能帮你做什么。这次先从 Pro 用户开始——也就是已经拥有 dot 或符合条件可以创建 dot 的用户。你的 dot 会有独立标签页，你还可以把 Codex、Projects、Images 等功能固定到标签栏上。部分用户会默认看到新界面。

你随时可以在「设置 > 新版 ChatGPT 设计」里打开或关闭它。

在更大范围推送之前，非常期待听到你的反馈！

英文原推文

We’re also working on a new mobile experience for ChatGPT!

It’s easier to get to your favorite features and discover what you can do in ChatGPT. We’re starting with Pro users who have a dot or are eligible to create one. Your dot gets its own tab, and you can pin Codex, Projects, Images, and more to the tab bar. Some of you will see the new experience by default.

You can turn it on or off anytime in Settings > New ChatGPT Design.

Super excited to hear your feedback before we roll it out more widely!

item.title: [Peter Yang] Gemini 4 Neon 好评如潮，我做了个对比视频
item.description:
@petergyang · 查看 X 原推文 ↗

中文翻译

Gemini 4 Neon 最近好评如潮，所以我做了个新视频，把它和我日常干活最爱用的 Opus 5.5 放在一起比了比。

几点感受：

1. 从我的测试看，Opus 在 3D 和设计上还是更强，但 Neon 在写作和「性格」上已经不相上下、甚至更好，这已经很了不起了。

2. @Google 的 Gemini 4 一共有 3 个模型，但实际上我觉得 99% 的任务我都会用 Neon。它比 Carbon 快得多，效果却一样好。

3. 每月 100 美元的 Gemini Ultra 订阅挺划算。你能拿到 Gemini 4、YouTube Premium 家庭版（我最爱的订阅，没有之一，YouTube 和 Music 都免广告）、20 TB 存储空间放照片和文件，还有更多。

📌 想看我在 5 个使用场景里实测 Neon 对 Opus，点这里：https://t.co/irRiNDdqgY

英文原推文

Gemini 4 Neon is getting rave reviews, so I made a new video comparing it to Opus 5.5, my favorite model for everyday work.

Some takeaways:

1. Opus is still better at 3D and design from my testing, but Neon is on par or better at writing and personality, which is a huge accomplishment.

2. @Google Gemini 4 has 3 models, but in reality I think I'll use Neon for 99% of tasks. It's much faster than Carbon and its results are just as good.

3. The $100/mo Gemini Ultra subscription is a steal. You get Gemini 4, YouTube Premium Family (my favorite subscription ever) for ad-free YouTube and Music, 20 TB of storage for all your photos and files, and more.

📌 Watch me test Neon vs Opus across 5 use cases here: https://t.co/irRiNDdqgY
